info.title: Obsura API
info.summary: Review-first sanitization workflows, studio assets, and job orchestration for Obsura.
info.description:
Obsura API is the review-first workflow and orchestration layer for Obsura.

The API supports:
- persistent studio assets for custom detection and reusable configurations
- reviewable jobs and run history
- text-first and screenshot-first sanitization workflows
- transformation behavior beyond plain placeholder replacement
- image-region protection flows for blur, pixelation, masks, and overlays

This OpenAPI document is intended for direct import into API clients such as Postman.

schema.title: Response Healthcheck Api V1 Health Get

get.description: List saved patterns in reverse creation order.

schema.title: Response List Patterns Api V1 Studio Patterns Get

post.description: Create a reusable detection pattern with an optional default transformation.

get.description: Fetch one saved pattern by identifier.

patch.description: Update part of a saved pattern without replacing the whole record.

post.description: Create an exact-value pattern directly from a selected value.

schema.title: Response List Custom Entities Api V1 Studio Entities Get

post.description: Create a reusable custom entity with one or more detection definitions.

get.description: Fetch one saved custom entity by identifier.

patch.description: Update part of a saved custom entity.

get.description: List saved packs, profiles, and presets.

schema.title: Response List Configurations Api V1 Studio Configurations Get

post.description: Create a reusable pack, profile, or preset.

get.description: Fetch one saved configuration asset by identifier.

patch.description: Update part of a saved configuration asset.

get.description: Search across saved studio assets and persisted jobs.

schema.title: Response Search Studio Api V1 Studio Search Get

get.description: List persisted jobs with findings and generated outputs.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

get.description: Fetch one persisted job by identifier.

post.description: Apply review decisions to findings within a persisted job.
Analyze text-like content into reviewable findings and optionally persist a job.
Transform a persisted text job after review decisions and overrides are applied.
Run a one-shot analyze-plus-transform flow while still producing reviewable findings.
Analyze an uploaded image or screenshot into reviewable regions.
Apply image-region transformations and persist the generated output.
